slug: 2026-07-06 Gabon Inaugurates First Tier III Datacenter to Boost Digital Sovereignty

facts.fact: TechAfrica News reports the ST Digital Gabon datacenter was officially inaugurated on 4 July 2026, offering hosting to government and business, with preferential hosting rates for ministry-backed startups.
facts.system: ST Digital Gabon data centre, Nkok

facts.fact: TechAfrica News reports the inaugurated ST Digital Gabon datacenter was built to Tier III international standards; no certifying body is named.
